description: This file contains SCSS mixins for a grid system used in a Bootstrap-based theme. It defines reusable styles for containers, rows, and columns across different screen sizes, facilitating responsive design.

methods.name: container-fixed
methods.description: Creates a fixed-width, centered container with gutters.

methods.name: make-row
methods.description: Creates a row wrapper for columns with negative margins to offset columns.

methods.name: make-xs-column
methods.description: Defines styling for extra small columns with relative widths and paddings.

methods.name: make-xs-column-offset
methods.description: Offsets extra small columns by a specified number of columns.

methods.name: make-xs-column-push
methods.description: Pushes extra small columns to the right by a specified number of columns.

methods.name: make-xs-column-pull
methods.description: Pulls extra small columns to the left by a specified number of columns.

methods.name: make-sm-column
methods.description: Defines styling for small columns, applying media queries for responsive behavior.

methods.name: make-sm-column-offset
methods.description: Offsets small columns for screens above the small width breakpoint.

methods.name: make-sm-column-push
methods.description: Pushes small columns to the right for screens above the small width breakpoint.

methods.name: make-sm-column-pull
methods.description: Pulls small columns to the left for screens above the small width breakpoint.

methods.name: make-md-column
methods.description: Defines styling for medium columns with responsive media queries.

methods.name: make-md-column-offset
methods.description: Offsets medium columns for screens above the medium width breakpoint.

methods.name: make-md-column-push
methods.description: Pushes medium columns for screens above the medium width breakpoint.

methods.name: make-md-column-pull
methods.description: Pulls medium columns for screens above the medium width breakpoint.

methods.name: make-lg-column
methods.description: Defines styling for large columns with responsive media queries.

methods.name: make-lg-column-offset
methods.description: Offsets large columns for screens above the large width breakpoint.

methods.name: make-lg-column-push
methods.description: Pushes large columns to the right for screens above the large width breakpoint.

methods.name: make-lg-column-pull
methods.description: Pulls large columns to the left for screens above the large width breakpoint.
